conclusions.text: The 247-row retained #446 crosswalk agrees with the current-main baseline native IDs and aggregate source_member_ids: 241 direct native locations and six members mapped through two aggregate targets, covering 243 distinct Atlas target IDs. Native source names agree with native feature names; the six aggregate source names are unchanged from the pinned prior crosswalk and are present in the corresponding baseline alias lists.
The exact 215 unit rows, 32 distinct parent rows and each parent-child inventory agree with issue #446 scope and current-main unit feature identity/name/parent values.

The original 2012 Paraguay geometry bytes exceed the retention limit and were not independently rechecked in this work. This packet cannot establish the original source geometry, legal/current municipal boundaries, province relationship, completeness, source-name-to-member-ID truth for aggregate rows, or region approval.
